description: Minimal, web-based system monitor with Docker support, live metrics, alerts, and a built-in file browser—all bundled into a single binary

summary.one_liner: Simon is a lightweight, single-binary, web-based system monitor written in Rust that adds Docker container stats, live metrics, alerts, and a file browser.
summary.what_it_does: Simon serves a web interface that shows live and historical CPU, memory, disk usage, disk I/O, and network metrics with interactive charts. It monitors per-container resource usage and lets you view and search Docker container logs through Docker's API. A built-in file browser lets you navigate directories you expose, preview file contents, upload files with drag-and-drop, create folders, move and delete items, and download with HTTP range request support. Alert rules use custom thresholds for CPU, memory, disk, and network, and can notify via Telegram, ntfy, or custom webhooks, with pre-configured notification templates. Configuration is done through CLI flags or environment variables such as port, bind address, update interval, bcrypt password hash, and SQLite database path.
use_cases: monitor a small Linux server or embedded device
watch Docker container CPU and memory usage
view and search container logs in a browser
browse and upload files on a remote machine via web
set threshold alerts sent to Telegram or ntfy
self-host a lightweight dashboard on low-power hardware
how_to_run: Download the prebuilt binary from the Releases page, then run: chmod +x simon && ./simon
Or with Docker: docker run -d --name simon -p 30000:30000 -v /sys:/sys:ro -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro -v /:/fs:ro -v ./simon-data:/app/simon-data alibahmanyar/simon
Enable file browsing with the SIMON_SERVE_DIRS environment variable or --serve-dir flag
Or use Docker Compose with the provided YAML and run: docker-compose up -d
Build from source: git clone the repo, then run make web-setup, make web, and make release (requires Rust and Bun)
notable: Single self-contained binary with no external dependencies to install
Designed for resource-constrained environments such as embedded Linux
Docker container stats and log viewer built into the same interface
File browser with range-request downloads for resumable transfers and media streaming
Alert notifications to Telegram, ntfy, or webhooks with templates
caveats: Building from source requires both the Rust toolchain and Bun for the Svelte frontend
Docker mode needs the Docker socket and host mounts such as /sys and / to be mounted, which grants broad host visibility
README lists cross-platform support for Linux, Windows, Android, and FreeBSD, but Docker integration details are not specified for each platform
